settings.description: Prayer Portals are beautifully designed cards that help you bring both your joys and struggles to God. Connect your emotions with Scripture and discover new ways to pray.

settings.heading: Helping You Pray Without Shame or Confusion

settings.text: Prayer Portals were born from a simple observation: many of us want to connect with God but struggle to find the words. Whether you're feeling overwhelmed, grateful, confused, or hopeful—these cards meet you where you are.

Each card connects an emotion or need with relevant Scripture and a prayer starter. They won't pray for you, but they'll help you begin. Created in Christchurch, New Zealand, for youth ministries, small groups, and anyone seeking a deeper prayer life.

settings.verse_text: "Your word is a lamp for my feet, a light on my path."

settings.heading: How Prayer Portals Work
settings.description: Three simple steps to transform your prayer life

settings.title: Identify Your Feeling
settings.description: Browse the cards until you find the emotion, need, or desire that resonates with what you're experiencing right now.

settings.title: Discover Scripture
settings.description: Flip the card over to find Bible verses that speak directly to your situation, connecting God's Word to your heart.

settings.title: Begin Your Prayer
settings.description: Use the prayer starter as a launching point. Let it guide you into honest, meaningful conversation with God.

settings.heading: Experience Prayer Portals
settings.description: Drag the cards around. Click one to flip it over and see how it works.
settings.hint_text: Drag cards to move them • Click to flip and reveal Scripture
